tagline: Premium Handcrafted Sofas. Delivered Across Montreal.
deliveryHours: Fast local delivery across Montreal & surrounding areas - order via WhatsApp and we arrange a day that suits you
whatsappDefaultMessage: Hi Atelier Sofa Montreal! I'm interested in your premium handcrafted sofas. Do you deliver to my area in Montreal or the surrounding areas? Could you share pricing, custom sizes, fabrics and colors? I'd pay on delivery - cash or check, no advance required.
hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week (always open)
deliveryNote: No walk-in showroom - view the catalogue and order via WhatsApp. We offer fast local delivery across Montreal & surrounding areas. Pay on delivery - cash on delivery or check & pay - zero advance required. Just message us to order.

valueProps.title: Handcrafted for Montreal
valueProps.text: Premium sofas built for Montreal homes, with custom sizes, fabrics and colors to match your space perfectly.

valueProps.title: Quality You Can Trust
valueProps.text: Every sofa is carefully inspected by our team before it reaches your door, so you can buy with confidence.

valueProps.title: Cash on Delivery & Check

howItWorks.title: Choose Your Sofa
howItWorks.text: Browse our catalogue and pick the sofa you love - custom sizes, fabrics and colors available to suit your home.

howItWorks.title: Message Us on WhatsApp
howItWorks.text: Tap the WhatsApp button on any sofa - your message arrives pre-filled so we know exactly what you want.

howItWorks.title: Book Fast Delivery
howItWorks.text: We deliver fast across Montreal & surrounding areas - we arrange a delivery that suits your schedule.
